meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug issues by investigating logs, database state, and git history

copy.tagline: 通过日志、数据库和 Git 历史快速定位问题根因
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从日志和代码历史中定位 bug
copy.tagline_en: Quickly root-cause issues from logs, database state, and git history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to find bugs from logs, database, and git history

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你调试问题：它会检查日志、数据库状态和 Git 历史，然后给出调试报告，说明问题原因和下一步操作。
howto.when: 当你遇到手动测试或实现中的问题，并描述具体现象（如错误信息、预期行为）时触发。

say.text: 我测试登录功能时遇到报错，帮我查查日志。
say.note: Claude 会检查日志并分析错误。

say.text: 数据库里用户状态不对，帮我查一下。
say.note: Claude 会查询数据库并返回结果。

say.text: 最近代码改了什么？帮我看看 Git 历史。
say.note: Claude 会检查 Git 状态和最近提交。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you debug issues by examining logs, database state, and git history, then provides a debug report with root cause and next steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you describe a problem encountered during manual testing or implementation, such as error messages or unexpected behavior.

say_en.text: I got an error when testing login, please check the logs.
say_en.note: Claude will examine logs and analyze errors.

say_en.text: The user status in the database is wrong, please check it.
say_en.note: Claude will query the database and return findings.

say_en.text: What changed in the code recently? Check git history.
say_en.note: Claude will check git status and recent commits.
